hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); ws=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.." && pwd); case "$f" in "$ws/Backend Demo"/*) echo "Blocked: Backend Demo is the client's reference repo and is read-only. Copy what you need into Claude/docs/ instead."; exit 2;; esac; case "$f" in "$(dirname "$ws")/Extra Space old"/*) echo "Blocked: Extra Space old is the client's old production code (live secrets committed) and is read-only. Copy what you need into Claude/docs/ instead."; exit 2;; esac; case "$f" in "$ws"/CMS/*|"$ws"/API/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */.claude/*|*/.cursor/*|*/.agents/*) echo "Blocked: tool folders (.claude, .cursor, .agents) belong in the workspace root Claude/, never inside a code repo."; exit 2;; esac; b=$(basename "$f"); case "$b" in CLAUDE*.md|AGENTS.md|GEMINI.md|.claude*|.cursor*|.mcp.json|skills-lock.json) echo "Blocked: $b belongs in the workspace root (Claude/.claude or Claude/.cursor), never inside a code repo."; exit 2;; esac; case "$b" in *.md) [ -e "$f" ] || { echo "Blocked: new markdown inside a code repo. Put notes, plans and handovers under Claude/docs/."; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0

s=$(jq -r '.tool_input.sql // empty' | tr '\n\r\t' '   ' | sed -E 's#/\*[^*]*\*+([^/*][^*]*\*+)*/# #g; s/^[[:space:]]+//; s/[[:space:];]+$//'); w=$(printf '%s' "$s" | awk '{print toupper($1)}'); case "$w" in SELECT|SHOW|DESCRIBE|DESC|EXPLAIN|WITH) ;; *) echo "Blocked: this MySQL MCP points at an OLD PRODUCTION database (SG or MY) and is read-only. Allowed: SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN, WITH." >&2; exit 2;; esac; case "$s" in *';'*) echo "Blocked: one statement per call on the production database." >&2; exit 2;; esac; printf '%s' "$s" | grep -qiE 'into[[:space:]]+(out|dump)file|for[[:space:]]+(update|share)|lock[[:space:]]+in[[:space:]]+share' && { echo "Blocked: no file output or row locks on the production database." >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

for p in $(cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/dev-ports" 2>/dev/null); do pid=$(lsof -ti tcp:$p 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$pid" ] && [ "$(ps -o ppid= -p "$pid" | tr -d ' ')" = "1" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null; done; true

[ -f /tmp/claude-extraspace-cs-dirty ] || exit 0; fail=0; sort -u /tmp/claude-extraspace-cs-dirty | while IFS= read -r f; do d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != / ] && ! ls "$d"/*.csproj >/dev/null 2>&1; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; ls "$d"/*.csproj 2>/dev/null; done | sort -u > /tmp/claude-extraspace-csproj; rm -f /tmp/claude-extraspace-cs-dirty; while IFS= read -r c; do out=$(dotnet build "$c" --nologo -v q 2>&1) || { fail=1; echo "dotnet build FAILED after this turn's C# edits: $c"; echo "$out" | grep -iE 'error' | head -15; }; done < /tmp/claude-extraspace-csproj; rm -f /tmp/claude-extraspace-csproj; [ "$fail" = 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2
